subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should OpenClaw standardize persistent question summaries and Skip across native clients while making the expanded Control UI question panel take over the composer?
rationale: This PR deliberately changes cross-client interaction policy and the shared transport contract; tests and screenshots cannot establish whether that permanent product behavior is the intended long-term direction.

options.title: Sponsor the parity direction
options.body: Accept persistent summaries, Skip, and web composer takeover after native runtime proof confirms the implementation on iOS, macOS, and Android.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep a smaller recovery or client-specific fix and defer permanent cross-surface interaction parity until a product owner defines the desired UX contract.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold the branch until the intended native and web question interaction model has explicit owner agreement.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the parity direction
recommendation.body: Accept persistent summaries, Skip, and web composer takeover after native runtime proof confirms the implementation on iOS, macOS, and Android.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and its current branch centralizes the affected shared and client-specific implementation work.
